status: PROPOSED freeze, every value except the ones listed under decided_by_owner is a PROPOSAL for the owner. The owner freezes it: copy to pr6_hyd1_freeze.json (same folder), set "frozen": true, fill the null items (negatives_ignored after the pre-check job, heldout_truth.external_set after owner question 4), set owner_signature, commit. Nothing is built or scored before that commit; pr6_hyd1_build.py and pr6_hyd1_report.py refuse a file that is missing or not frozen.
target: hyd1_like (KS0017, A0ACE4KFX7, H. capsulatum, adhesion slice; leave-cluster-out, reported partial)
members: the query + the 32 drift-supported hits (class supported_homolog, query coverage >= 0.5) with a named fine clade (29 hits, 3 clades); the 3 hits without a fine clade are listed and excluded (pr6_hyd1_members.py)
extra_calls_note: decision 8; 5 x 32,491 / 10,000 = 16.2455 over the four kept proteomes
labelled_rule: a proteome protein is labelled (not an extra call) when phmmer of A0ACE4KFX7 against that proteome finds it at E <= 1e-5
proteome_other_hydrophobin_note: PROPOSAL (owner question 8): proteome proteins hit by a hydrophobin-class Pfam model at GA (list from the pre-check job) are true hydrophobins, so they are left out of the extra-call count like labelled proteins and reported on their own line. 'count' would charge them as false hits.
negatives_ignored_note: TO FILL from the pre-check job (pr6_hyd1_negatives_precheck.sbatch): the shared negatives found by phmmer of A0ACE4KFX7 at E <= 1e-5. Candidate named only by reading controls.tsv, NOT yet a member: B6QUR1 (MP1, Pfam HsbA); the job decides. An empty list at the freeze is allowed only if the job ran and found none.

training_rule.note: decision 7, provisional, applied AFTER the independence rule. reading total = the ecm33 code (5 sequences in all outside clades together, in >= 2 clades); per_clade = >= 2 outside clades each with >= 5 sequences (owner question 2; per_clade leaves only the Kiss unit and Leotiomycetes buildable)

independence_note: PROPOSAL (the ecm33 owner decision carried over, owner question 5): HEADLINE cluster30 (MMseqs2 30 percent identity, 50 percent coverage), second DESCRIPTIVE column none. A cluster: unit has one column (the held-out cluster is already removed).
min_u_note: PROPOSAL carried over from ecm33. u here = held-out members missed by every INDEPENDENT comparator (Pfam GA panel, relaxed panel, single-seed phmmer); the jackhmmer-from-seed ceiling is reported but never enters u. The custom model must recover ceil(u/2) of u.

alignment_check.note: PROPOSAL; the stop condition of the build. min_columns is 40, not the ecm33 100: the query is 98 residues and 31 of 32 hits are 61 to 197 residues, so 100 occupied columns cannot be reached. A cysteine-column check as in analysis/hydrophobin_truth/lco.py is NOT proposed: whether KS0017 has the 8 cysteines is unchecked.

evalue_db_size_note: PROPOSAL: -Z for the seed comparators over the tiny held-out file = the UniRef50 2025_03 sequence count of the round 2 provenance (uniprot_fasta_sequences), so E <= 1e-5 means what it meant in the search that found the members

comparators.pfam_ga: the eight hydrophobin-class Pfam models of the panel (PF01185 PF06766 PF22354 PF28987 PF29802 PF29785 PF29465 PF12296), hmmsearch --cut_ga; INDEPENDENT
comparators.relaxed_panel: data/sorting_hat/hydrophobin_relaxed.hmm (frozen 2.6-bit full-sequence cutoff, --nobias --cut_ga; committed 2026-10); INDEPENDENT; the 8-cysteine condition of the module is not applied (reported as a second descriptive column only if the owner asks)
comparators.phmmer_seed: phmmer -Z <evalue_db_size> -E 1e-5 of the single Kiss protein A0ACE4KFX7 over the held-out members; INDEPENDENT of the training alignment; not run in the Kiss unit (the seed is the held-out member)
comparators.jackhmmer_seed_ceiling: jackhmmer -N 3 --incE 1e-5 from the single Kiss protein, same -Z; CEILING: it found the members, so it recovers them by construction; reported, never in u

heldout_truth.within_member_set: clade units and cluster units of the drift-supported members: search-defined and circular, every cell descriptive
heldout_truth.external_set_note: OWNER QUESTION 4. Proposal: the 9 Swiss-Prot hydrophobins without a hydrophobin Pfam cross-reference (analysis/hydrophobin_truth/nopfam9.faa) and the other curated truth proteins that the pre-check relatedness table shows within E 1e-3 of the Kiss protein, scored as an extra descriptive line after the same 30 percent exclusion. Null until decided.

weak_evidence_rows_listed_by_name: the query A0ACE4KFX7 is locus_confirmed (not row_verified); the members are homologs by iterated search, not curated hyd1_like
